firstAlbum.title: Bellevue Kitchen Countertops 2025
firstAlbum.heading: Kitchen Countertop Projects – Bellevue, WA
firstAlbum.paragraph: Portfolio of Bellevue kitchen countertop projects: laser templated quartz, granite, and marble with tight ≤1/16" seams, color-matched epoxy, and steel brackets for >12" overhangs. Scope includes removal, plywood build-up, sink/faucet/cooktop cutouts, waterfall islands, and stone sealing. Completed in West Bellevue, Medina, Clyde Hill, Eastgate.

secondAlbum.title: Bellevue Bathroom Countertops 2025
secondAlbum.heading: Bathroom Countertop Projects – Bellevue, WA
secondAlbum.paragraph: Portfolio of Bellevue bathroom countertop projects: laser-templated quartz, granite, and marble vanity tops; 3 cm slabs; undermount sink cutouts, faucet holes, 4" or full-height splashes, and clean silicone joints. We handle removal/disposal, plywood build-up where needed, tight wall scribe fits, and sealing on natural stone. Seams ≤1/16" with color-matched epoxy; eased or mitered edges. Completed in West Bellevue, Medina, Clyde Hill, and Somerset—guest baths to primary suites.
